title: Gaussian halfspace stability
statement: For real parameters $\rho$ and $\alpha$, define the Gaussian halfspace stability to be $0$ when $\alpha\leq 0$, to be $1$ when $1\leq\alpha$, and otherwise to be the standard bivariate Gaussian probability that both coordinates $X$ and $\rho X+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}Y$ are at most the standard Gaussian quantile at $\alpha$, where $X$ and $Y$ are independent standard Gaussian random variables.
